services_overview.heading: Full general contracting, led by master carpenters.
services_overview.intro: Renova runs the complete general-contracting scope — design-build, permitting, project management, budgeting, and multi-trade coordination — with the same crew that self-performs the structural concrete, framing, and finish carpentry. process.heading: From first conversation to final walkthrough.
process.intro: Every project follows the same real customer journey, whether it's a full custom home or a single-room renovation.

steps.title: Vision
steps.text: We start by listening — understanding how you want to live in the space and what the project needs to achieve.

steps.title: Collaboration
steps.text: Your ideas and our trade experience come together early, before anything is locked in on paper.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Layout, massing, and material direction take shape as an early concept for you to react to.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: The concept becomes detailed, engineer-stamped drawings — in-house 3D modeling keeps every decision visual.

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: Permitting, scheduling, and budgeting are locked down before a single crew shows up on-site.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: Our own crews build it, led on-site every day by a Red Seal trade leader — not handed off to sub-crews.

steps.title: Finishing
steps.text: Trim, millwork, and the fine details that separate a good build from a photographed one.

steps.title: Cleaning
steps.text: The site is cleaned and prepped for a final walkthrough — ready to move in, not just ready to leave.

steps.title: Goodbyes
steps.text: Final handover and walkthrough — and, for most clients, the start of a relationship we hear from again.

items.question: What trades does Renova Design Build actually handle?
items.answer: Renova runs the full general-contracting scope — design-build, permitting, budgeting, scheduling, and multi-trade coordination — and self-performs five core areas: design-build with in-house 3D drafting (SketchUp), structural concrete and formwork, heavy timber and structural remediation, high-end architectural finishing (siding, trim, custom stairs, cabinetry), and commercial/multi-family subcontracting. Every scope is led on-site by one of our Red Seal trade leaders.

items.question: Who's actually on my job site — is it Renova's crew or a subcontractor?
items.answer: The person who quotes the job is the person running it on-site. Bill Sr., Bill Jr., and Nicholas lead every project directly rather than handing it off to unsupervised sub-crews.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes — full WorkSafeBC coverage and liability insurance across commercial, residential, and remote industrial work, with Red Seal Journeyman Carpenters and a Journeyman Building Technologist leading every project.

items.question: Do you only do residential work, or commercial too?
items.answer: Both. Renova works as the primary design-build contractor for custom homes and community facilities, and as a high-precision subcontractor for large commercial developers — including high-security utility sites like BC Hydro substations.

items.question: Can you take on projects in remote or First Nations communities?
items.answer: Yes — Renova has managed turnkey construction for First Nations communities, including educational facilities, administrative offices, new housing, and multi-property renovations, coordinated remotely with on-site trade leadership.

items.question: Do you provide 3D drawings before construction starts?
items.answer: Yes — in-house SketchUp 3D modeling and CAD integration, carrying a project from initial concept through to construction-ready, engineer-stamped drawings.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We're based in Surrey, BC, serving the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland.
